Bug Title: Disabling Biometric Login Does Not Request Confirmation

1. Open Security & Preferences.
2. Locate Biometric Login.
3. Turn the setting from ON to OFF.
4. Observe whether a confirmation prompt is displayed.

Actual Result: Turning Biometric Login from ON to OFF disables it without asking for confirmation.
Evidence/Notes: Confirm the expected confirmation behaviour with Product/Design. If required, include clear Confirm and Cancel actions.

Module/Screen: Profile – Edit Profile / Email & Mobile Number
Bug Title: UI Allows Email and Mobile Number to Be Edited Together Despite One-Field-at-a-Time Restriction
Preconditions: User is logged in and has an existing email address and mobile number in the profile.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open the Profile screen.
2. Select Edit Profile.
3. Modify both the Email Address and Mobile Number fields.
4. Tap Save Changes.
5. Observe the validation response.
Test Data: Existing email address and mobile number; enter valid replacement values in both fields.
Expected Result: The UI should enforce the one-field-at-a-time restriction before submission. When the user edits one field, the other field should remain unchanged or the app should clearly prevent simultaneous edits. The restriction should be communicated through clear inline guidance.
Actual Result: The screen allows the user to edit both Email Address and Mobile Number at the same time. Only after attempting to save does the app display: “You can change only one field at a time. Update either your email or your phone number.”
Evidence/Notes: Screenshot evidence: Screenshot_20261030-154332.Gus Money.png. Improve the form-level validation/interaction so users cannot enter an invalid combination and receive the error only after submission. Video evidence: screen-20261030-153814.mp4.

Bug Title: Mobile Number Verification Message Is Displayed When Updating Email Address
Preconditions: User is logged in and can access the Edit Personal Details screen.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open Profile and navigate to Edit Personal Details.
2. Change the Email Address only.
3. Observe the information message displayed below the contact fields.
4. Repeat by changing the Mobile Number only and compare the message.
Test Data: Valid new email address; valid new mobile number.
Expected Result: The information message should match the field being updated. For an email change, it should state that a verification code will be sent to the new email address. For a mobile number change, it should state that a verification code will be sent to the new mobile number.
Actual Result: When the Email Address is changed, the information message still states: “We will send a verification code to this number to confirm changes.” The message is correct when the Mobile Number is changed.
Evidence/Notes: Screenshot evidence: Screenshot_20261030-154600.Gus Money.png (email update) and Screenshot_20261030-154603.Gus Money.png (mobile number update).

Module/Screen: Admin Panel – User Profile / Mobile App – Phone Verification
Bug Title: Mobile App Verification Status Is Not Reset After Admin Changes the User’s Mobile Number
Preconditions: A user account has a verified mobile number. An administrator has permission to update the user’s mobile number from the admin panel.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Log in to the admin panel.
2. Open the relevant user profile.
3. Change the user’s existing mobile number and save the update.
4. Open or refresh the Gus Money mobile app using the affected user account.
5. Check the updated mobile number and its verification status.
Test Data: Existing verified mobile number; replacement mobile number updated by the administrator.
Expected Result: After an administrator changes the user’s mobile number, the mobile app should reflect the updated number and reset the verification status for that new number to Unverified/Pending. The user should be required to verify the new number before it is treated as verified.
Actual Result: The mobile app does not clear/reset the previous verification status after the administrator changes the user’s mobile number. The updated number continues to appear as verified.
Evidence/Notes: Video evidence: screen-20261030-155508.mp4; Gus Money.mp4. Verify that the admin update invalidates the previous phone verification state and that the mobile app refreshes the updated number and status.

Module/Screen: Admin Panel – User Account Status / Mobile App – Login
Bug Title: Inactive Account Displays Incorrect “This Session Was Signed Out” Message on Mobile Login
Preconditions: A user account exists and an administrator has changed its status to Inactive from the web admin panel.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Log in to the web admin panel.
2. Open the relevant user profile and change the account status to Inactive.
3. Save the change.
4. Open the Gus Money mobile app for the affected user.
5. Attempt to log in using the affected account credentials.
6. Observe the error message displayed.
Test Data: User account status: Inactive; valid login credentials for the affected account.
Expected Result: The mobile app should recognise that the account has been deactivated by the administrator and prevent login. It should display a clear and accurate message, such as “Your account is inactive. Please contact support for assistance.”
Actual Result: The mobile app displays the generic error message “This session was signed out” when the user attempts to log in to an account that has been marked Inactive by the administrator.
Evidence/Notes: Screenshot evidence: image(3).png. Verify that the account status returned by the backend is handled correctly by the mobile login flow and that the user receives an account-inactive message rather than a session sign-out message.

Bug Title: Newly Added Bank Account Fails to Connect and Displays “Try Connecting Again”
Preconditions: User is logged in and has access to Manage Connections. At least one bank account is already connected.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open the Gus Money mobile app.
2. Navigate to Manage Connections.
3. Select Connect another bank account.
4. Complete the bank connection flow for another bank.
5. Return to Manage Connections and check the newly added bank’s connection status.
Test Data: Existing connected bank: Hooli Bank; newly added bank: HooliGov Bank (as shown in the screenshot).
Expected Result: If the bank connection flow completes successfully, the newly added bank should appear with a connected/synced status. If the connection fails, the app should display a clear reason and an actionable recovery option.
Actual Result: The existing Hooli Bank connection displays “Last synced 1 min ago” with a connected indicator, while the newly added HooliGov Bank displays “Try connecting again” and does not show a successful connection status.
Evidence/Notes: Screenshot evidence: Screenshot_20261030-161332.png. Please investigate why the newly added bank connection is failing and verify the connection response/status handling. Confirm whether this is a provider-side connection failure or an app/backend integration issue.
